name: Pakistani Kush
summary: Pakistani Kush is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] from [[country:PK|Pakistan]], also called Old World Paki Kush. It is known mainly as one of the three parents commonly given for OG Kush, alongside [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] and [[lemon-thai|Lemon Thai]]. Where in Pakistan the population was collected is not documented.

sources.title: Everything You Need To Know About OG Kush
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: gives OG Kush as a three-way cross of Chemdawg, Lemon Thai, and Pakistani Kush.

sources.title: OG Kush
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: names the parent as an Old World Paki Kush crossed with Chemdawg. No source checked describes the landrace itself.
